_comment: Route policy read by the kit's hooks/route.mjs on every prompt and hooks/subagent.mjs at every subagent start (DES-13). Tunables only. groups: law group id -> words that activate it (whole-word, case-insensitive, matched against the prompt); the group ids must exist as '## GROUP - Title' sections in LAW.md, so an overlay group an adopter adds gets a line here. folders: top-level folder under root -> groups active whenever the session works there. alwaysForSubagents: groups every subagent receives even when nothing routed yet. alwaysForSessions: groups every session receives on its first prompt and again after a compaction or a clear, whatever the words and the folder (OWN-10); OWN carries how every decision is asked and researched, which no topic word routes. maxChars: cap per injection, under the host's 10,000-character limit. A route sticks for the session; entry.mjs clears it on a compaction or a clear. writerSkip: { groups, clauses } is law a writer session does not receive (owner ruling 29, 2026-10-20: work sessions answer their master tersely, so law about how to talk to the owner stays out of them). A writer session is one whose first prompt holds 'Reports to:' at the start of a line, a brief; a subagent is always a writer. groups: law group ids dropped whole. clauses: clause ids dropped one row at a time, the rest of the group still arrives (for example an owner-voice clause of OWN, or a whole VOICE group an adopter's overlay adds). Empty, as shipped, or absent: nothing is dropped. The mark is kept in <session>.role and cleared with the routes on a compaction or a clear.
_stateCard: GAME-13, read by hooks/entry.mjs at session start. A session that starts inside a repository whose top-level folder is mapped (in folders) to one of stateCard.groups gets a state card built from that repository's DECISIONS.md, HANDOFF.md and git. Map your games folder to GAME in folders to switch it on, for example "games": ["GAME", "DES"]. staleCommits: a hand-off further behind HEAD than this is flagged. lineChars, maxChars: size caps. closedWords (optional): the status words that mean a timeline row is closed. groups empty: no card. anyRepoWithHandoff (DES-14, default false): true also gives a card to any repository under root that holds HANDOFF.md or docs\HANDOFF.md, whatever its folder; the card then prints the hand-off's '## Next session' section as the next prompt.
